stories.title: Token Expiration Enforcement and TTL Index
stories.description: Implement expiration enforcement using expires_at field and MongoDB TTL index to automatically remove expired tokens. Ensure validation logic rejects expired tokens even before TTL cleanup.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; GAP: No expiration or TTL-based cleanup currently implemented for tokens

stories.title: Token Issuance Endpoint and Contract
stories.description: Create secure endpoint/service for issuing new bearer tokens with defined scope, expiration, and hashing before storage. Ensure contract aligns with schema and downstream validation.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; Code/Shared/brain_auth.py; GAP: No standardized token issuance contract exists

stories.title: Token Audit Logging and Traceability
stories.description: Implement audit logging for token lifecycle events including issuance, rotation, revocation, and validation failures. Logs must include token_id, event type, timestamp, and actor (system/admin).
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; Code/Shared/cost_guard.py; GAP: No centralized audit trail for token lifecycle events

stories.title: Rotation Policy Configuration
stories.description: Define configurable rotation policy (e.g., max token age, rotation interval, chain length limits) and enforce within rotation service logic.
stories.evidence: brain/machine_artifacts/content/sprint_plan.json:backlog_0_1_4_perplexity; GAP: No formal rotation policy defined
